How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 01-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AAI Medical Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AAI Medical Consultant (Non-Specialist Doctor) position is 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university to be eligible for the Medical Consultant post.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Medical Consultant (Non-Specialist Doctor) position in the Airports Authority of India recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Medical Consultant role is 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 3000/- per day for 6 hours of duty, with an additional Rs. 500/- for each extra hour worked.

faq.question: Q6. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: This is a temporary engagement for the Medical Consultant (Non-Specialist Doctor) position at the Airports Authority of India.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents via email to the specified address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any preference given to certain candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates with experience in Aviation/Government Establishments, PSUs, and retired doctors from Government Institutions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Consultant (Non-Specialist Doctor) post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job is located in Kolkata, at the Airports Authority of India, Regional Headquarters, Eastern Region.
